title: Two Hands in a Local Box: Decoupled Neuro-Symbolic State Gating, Defeasible Negative Provenance, and Companion Historiography
description:
Public release bundle for Two Hands in a Local Box by Henry Oscar Arthur McDonald: Volume I (Two Hands in a Local Box, 56 pp.), Volume II (The Age of Overkill and the Grounded Wire, 26 pp.), Failures, Parables & Crash Reports (13 pp., 9 verified dual-voice builder post-mortems), the adversarial Trilogy Redline & Vetting Report, and the MIT-licensed local ACID SQLite state-gating reference implementation (schema/schema.sql, scripts/, 11-test invariant harness, and Kestrel-7 20-step stateful contradiction gauntlet).

Privacy Note: Volume III (the complete unfiltered verbatim archive), The Overkill Crucible: Extended Archival History (2025–2026), and all raw private SQLite databases are intentionally withheld/gated pending independent verification of the core thesis and intent.
